whole_process_cpu: /usr/bin/time -l user+system, including setup, final drain and exit
build_command: PYTHONPATH=. scons release=1 CXXFLAGS=-g0 client_profile=full server=0 -j4
instrumentation: Stock built-in benchmark CPU and tick-duration counters only. No private probes or source patches.
policy: Global four building-gradient admissions per tick in both revisions; PR1220 is not included.
run_order: Serial paired games; alternate AB/BA by map and seed; reject both games if compiler/test/VM contention is detected.
limitations: Short early-game comparison on one Mac; not long-game or slower-device coverage.
Simulation trajectories may differ, so this measures complete-game cost rather than isolated kernels.
Host guard cannot detect all OS/background activity.
Tick percentiles are per-game percentiles, not pooled percentiles.
Natural early game ends are retained; per-tick metrics use executed ticks.
